scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && vite build && wrangler deploy --minify
scripts.setup: npm run build && wrangler deploy --minify && npm run db:migrations:apply

DB.description: D1 registry for zones and operator audit records. It is provisioned automatically and migrated during deployment.

BOT_TRAFFIC_ANALYTICS.description: R2 bucket containing zone-keyed traffic rollups and monitoring outcomes.

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example `https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`.

POLICY_AUD.description: The AUD tag for the Cloudflare Access application protecting this Worker.

OPERATOR_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated browser origins allowed to submit rollback confirmations. Empty defaults to same-origin only.

CLOUDFLARE_READ_TOKEN.description: Read-only Cloudflare API token used by scheduled GraphQL analytics collection and the model-facing MCP search connection (search only, never execute). Permissions: Zone > Zone > Read, Zone > Zone WAF > Read, Zone > Analytics > Read, restricted to registered zones/account. Do not grant write permissions.

APPROVAL_TOKEN_SECRET.description: A long random cryptographic secret used to sign single-use email approval tokens. Not a Cloudflare API token. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
